sources.articleTitle: President’s bodyguard shot in head over old rivalry in UP
Army jawan posted with President’s Bodyguard shot in U.P.; condition stable

headline: Presidential Bodyguard Sustains Gunshot Injury During Uttar Pradesh Visit
seoTitle: Presidential Bodyguard Shot in Uttar Pradesh
metaDescription: A soldier serving with the President’s Bodyguard was shot in the head during a Diwali night altercation in a Uttar Pradesh village; police are searching.
aiSummaryBullets: A 28-year-old soldier assigned to the President’s Bodyguard sustained a gunshot wound to the head while visiting his home village in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh.
Local reports indicate the shooting occurred on Diwali night following a confrontation with neighbors stemming from an alleged long-standing rivalry.
Police have deployed three separate teams to locate two suspects who fled the scene, while the victim remains hospitalized in stable condition after surgery.
aiContextParagraph: On the night of the Diwali festival, a violent altercation took place in Gopalpur Khadana village, located within the Baghpat district of Uttar Pradesh, India. The incident involved an off-duty soldier currently serving in the President’s Bodyguard, identified in reports as 28-year-old Saurabh Tomar. According to local authorities and media accounts, the soldier and his brother were confronted by neighbors during a dispute linked to a previous, ongoing rivalry. During the escalation, the soldier was struck in the head by gunfire, and his brother sustained severe head injuries. Both individuals were subsequently transported to medical facilities, with the soldier undergoing emergency surgical intervention in the city of Meerut. The local police department has initiated a formal investigation and is currently pursuing two suspects who reportedly fled the location immediately after the incident. Official efforts to apprehend the individuals remain active as the case develops.
whyItIsViral: This incident has gained media attention due to the high-profile military affiliation of the victim and the violent nature of the attack during a national holiday.
